assessment.summary: Move protected offline work behind one loopback service that owns identity, encryption, audit, model routing, backup, and legal-hold enforcement.

nonNegotiables: No evidence or prompt egress to a non-loopback endpoint.
Only approved facts with exact verified citations may be displayed.
assumptions: The firm supplies a managed workstation and physical safeguards.
No measured local-model latency or memory budget was supplied.

opportunities.title: Own the offline PHI boundary
opportunities.summary: Place protected lifecycle controls behind an authenticated same-origin loopback service.
opportunities.diagnosis: The browser pilot minimized cloud egress but no component owned identity, encrypted originals, durable audit, recovery, or retention enforcement.

evidence.claim: Untrusted document text reached CSV output without formula neutralization.
Untrusted files reached browser parsers without explicit resource budgets.
Protected lifecycle policy was delegated to one unauthenticated IndexedDB record.

desiredInvariants: Protected evidence, prompts, and model responses never leave loopback.
Original and canonical evidence is stored using authenticated encryption.
Every approval and export is attributable to an authenticated identity.
Legal hold is enforced at the storage deletion boundary.
Every visible factual claim maps to an approved fact and verified citation.

options.title: Strengthened browser pilot
options.summary: Keep browser persistence and add focused parser and export controls.

findingCoverage.rationale: A safe CSV serializer directly removes the observed formula path.
Browser parser budgets directly constrain the observed resource path.

tradeoffs.assessment: Parser and export paths improve, while identity, encryption, audit, and recovery remain ambient endpoint concerns.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Run adversarial parser and spreadsheet export tests.

tradeoffs.assessment: Simple limits and cell encoding add negligible critical-path work.
Limits reduce worst-case allocation without adding a new process.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Measure browser peak memory during bounded imports.

tradeoffs.assessment: Oversized inputs fail early, but IndexedDB remains the sole recovery point.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Test rejected batches and browser-storage loss.

tradeoffs.assessment: No additional local service is introduced.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Confirm existing deployment workflow remains unchanged.

tradeoffs.assessment: The browser data model remains compatible.

residualRisks: No application-owned identity, encrypted originals, audit chain, backup, or legal hold.

workPackages: Add resource budgets and spreadsheet-safe encoding.
acceptanceCriteria: Oversized inputs are rejected and formula text is inert.
implementationReadiness.rollback: Revert the focused parser and export changes.

options.title: Loopback local appliance
options.summary: Run the UI, encrypted vault, audit service, and Ollama gateway on loopback.

findingCoverage.rationale: The structural change does not replace the safe CSV serializer.
The local boundary still requires format-specific resource limits.

tradeoffs.assessment: Loopback enforcement centralizes encryption, identity, audit, model routing, backups, and holds.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Test remote-host rejection, authentication, ciphertext tampering, audit tampering, and legal hold.

tradeoffs.assessment: Encryption and local model inference add CPU time and same-origin serialization.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Benchmark native and OCR PDFs with the approved hardware and model.

tradeoffs.assessment: Ollama retains model weights and inference state in addition to browser OCR buffers.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Measure combined browser, Node, and Ollama peak memory.

tradeoffs.assessment: Authenticated encryption and portable encrypted backups improve recovery, but one workstation remains one failure domain.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Complete backup restore and citation reproduction exercises.

tradeoffs.assessment: The firm must manage Ollama, vault passwords, endpoint policy, backups, and readiness checks.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Run the local runbook with an independent operator.

tradeoffs.assessment: Authoritative sources must be re-imported into a new vault instead of trusting browser-state migration.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Pilot a synthetic matter from import through restored backup.

residualRisks: Managed endpoint, MFA, physical security, incident response, and retention schedules remain firm responsibilities.
Human review remains necessary to establish logical support beyond byte matching.

workPackages: Implement encrypted vault, identity, sessions, audit, originals, backup, and legal hold.
Integrate structured local extraction and approved-fact query selection.
Validate offline operation and operational controls.
acceptanceCriteria: No evidence request reaches a non-loopback address.
Only approved facts with verified citations are displayed.
Backup restoration and audit verification pass.
migrationNotes: Do not automatically migrate protected browser IndexedDB data.
implementationReadiness.rollback: Stop the local service and preserve the encrypted vault; never move protected data into the public browser profile.

opportunities.recommendation: Use the local appliance for protected offline work and retain the strengthened browser profile only for synthetic demonstrations.

openQuestions: Which model and hardware profile will the firm approve?
Which operating-system MFA and browser-management baseline applies?
What retention schedules and encrypted backup destinations are approved?
